subject: Model shortlist, context window needs & token runway for onboarding
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia@lumina.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Model shortlist, context window needs & token runway for onboarding

Sofia — thanks for the kickoff earlier. I wanted to capture a concise starting point so CS and Eng have alignment for the implementation planning:

1) Ask / decisions we need from Lumina before kickoff
- Typical prompt + response lengths (avg and 95th percentile)
- Any use cases that require >8k context (documents, multi-turn histories, final prompt concatenation)
- Expected daily and monthly active sessions for launch (and 3x growth target)

2) Initial model shortlist (candidates for evaluation during pilot) — selected to balance latency, cost, and longer context support where possible
- Redwood-8k-v1 (quantized): lower-cost, predictable latency for 8k window workloads
- Llama-2-13B-chat: strong instruction-following and good inference performance at medium scale
- Mistral-Instruct-7B: efficient option for heavy request volumes with caching

3) Token/runway sketch (very preliminary)
- Assumptions: avg user session = 400 tokens (120 prompt / 280 response); 5k DAU at launch; 30-day month.
- Monthly tokens = 400 * 5,000 * 30 = 60,000,000 tokens/month (60M).
- Baseline compute tier: pilot reserved capacity to handle 100 qps sustained with 3x burst headroom.

4) Context window guidance
- If you have frequent >8k single-request context (e.g., long docs + chat state), we should prioritize a 16k-capable model for that route or plan server-side truncation/prefix caching.

Next steps: can you (Sofia or Raj) share a short token export or a sample of 500 raw prompts/responses (anonymized) and an estimate of DAU by traffic tier? I’ll schedule a 30-minute model-fit sync with Grace + Neha once we have that.

Thanks — Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0178
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Martinez <sofia@lumina.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model shortlist, context window needs & token runway for onboarding

Rishi / Neha — quick internal notes before we get Lumina's export: 

- The 60M/month calculation above is useful as an upper-bound starting point, but we should break into routes (chat vs document-summarize vs embeddings). Embedding volume can change slots significantly.
- For Lumina's product, if they attach per-session metadata (user profile + conversation + doc excerpts) that frequently hits 6–12k, we should propose a dual-route approach:
  * Route A (short): Redwood-8k-v1 for 95% of traffic — low cost, fast.
  * Route B (long): Llama-2-13B-chat or a 16k-capable variant for ~5% of heavy requests. Use prefix KV caching to keep effective compute lower for repeated document contexts.

- Operational asks for the pilot: 1) sample token export (500 rows) 2) 30-day peak hour estimate 3) list of fields that must be retained in prompts (so we can estimate token inflation).

I’ll draft a short evaluation plan (latency/cost per 1k tokens, expected p95 latency) and attach as a PDF once we confirm the traffic mix.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Principal, Customer Success Engineering | Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Martinez <sofia@lumina.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj@lumina.ai>, ops@lumina.ai
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2027 16:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Model shortlist, context window needs & token runway for onboarding

Thanks Rishi — attaching the token_export_sample + a short note from our product team. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- We do have structured metadata appended to every prompt (user profile, 3 recent messages, doc excerpt). Average tokens are higher than our estimates; the sample shows median = 540 tokens/session, 95th = ~2,400.
- About 8% of requests include a ~6k doc excerpt; 2% include multi-doc concatenation that pushes single-request context to ~11k.
- For launch we expect ~2,500 DAU but with heavy enterprise customers during onboarding weeks it can spike to 10k DAU for short windows.

Attachments:
- lumina_onboarding_token_estimate.xlsx (token export sample, 500 rows)
- product_note_long_context.pdf (notes on when they need long docs in a single call)

Questions:
1) Which model from your shortlist would you recommend if we need reliable correctness for the 11k single-request cases?
2) Can you propose an initial reserved capacity configuration (GPU types + slots) to cover the baseline + 3x spikes?

Sofia Martinez
Head of Product, LuminaAI
sofia@lumina.ai
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia@lumina.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 23 Oct 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model shortlist, context window needs & token runway for onboarding

Sofia — great context and thanks for the sample. Summary and concrete next steps below: 

Summary decisions
- Model routing: dual-route approach approved
  * Route A (short / bulk): Redwood-8k-v1 (quantized) for ~90% traffic — lowest cost, will use prefix caching for repeated doc snippets.
  * Route B (long / correctness): Llama-2-13B-chat with 16k window support for ~10% heavy single-request cases (covers your ~8% 6k cases and 2% 11k cases).
- Token runway: using your real median of 540 tokens/session and expected baseline 2,500 DAU -> monthly tokens = 540 * 2,500 * 30 = 40,500,000 (40.5M). Plan reserved capacity for 100 qps sustained with ability to burst to 300 qps for onboarding spikes.

Initial reserved capacity proposal (pilot)
- 2 x A100-80GB (or equivalent) nodes for Route A inference fleet (quantized runtime) — tuned for high-concurrency, lower-latency ops.
- 1 x A100-80GB node for Route B (16k Llama-2-13B-chat) with higher memory; enable auto-burst to additional spot capacity if p95 latency rises.
- Autoscaling policy: scale at 70% CPU/GPU utilization, with pre-warmed standby for canary traffic.

Operational handoffs / immediate asks
1) Confirm SSO and billing contact so we can open the Dedicated pilot contract (I’ll loop Sales Ops).
2) Provide a sample set of three high-priority prompts that must absolutely preserve >10k context — we’ll run them in evaluation to validate correctness under Llama-2-13B-chat.
3) Grace will share the evaluation matrix (latency / cost / correctness thresholds) Monday.

Attachments referenced: model_shortlist_notes.pdf (draft evaluation plan). I’ll set the 30-min model-fit sync for Monday 10/25 11:00am PT unless you request another slot.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the pilot kickoff.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Senior AE, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai
